board: DFRobot Fermion: STS35 High Accuracy Digital Temperature Sensor (SEN0434)
reason: Modelled from the Sensirion STS3x-DIS datasheet v6.1 (cmd 0x2400, 3-byte reply with CRC-8 0x31/0xFF, T=-45+175*S/65535) at address 0x4B (board pulls ADDR high via 10k); header order VCC,GND,SCL,SDA,RST,ADDR from the DFRobot silkscreen images. Part check printed PASS on ESP32 and Pico (sim test T=23.40C, PCB DRC clean).
breakoutPinoutSource: https://wiki.dfrobot.com/SEN0434 (silkscreen images https://dfimg.dfrobot.com/nobody/wiki/bc49f943d69f76a53486a1828d2ff295_0x0.png and https://dfimg.dfrobot.com/nobody/wiki/2eb5412af81b0951003aa1ada450d247.png: VCC square pad, GND, SCL, SDA, RST, ADDR); schematic https://dfimg.dfrobot.com/wiki/19346/SEN0434_fermion-sts35-high-accuracy-digital-temperature-sensor_schematics_1.0.pdf for pull-ups
